subject.title: [Bug]: Automatic WhatsApp replies do not preserve paragraph bubble boundaries

question: Should OpenClaw add an explicit paragraph-per-bubble mode, restore that behavior globally for `streaming.chunkMode: "newline"`, or retain the current paragraph-preference semantics?
rationale: Current source and documentation deliberately define `newline` as a preferred split boundary, while the requested behavior changes cross-channel message volume and may require a new public configuration contract.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in mode
options.body: Keep current `newline` compatibility and add a distinct paragraph-per-bubble policy whose boundaries survive chunking and coalescing.

options.title: Restore newline semantics globally
options.body: Make every blank-line paragraph a separate outbound message across channels using `newline`, accepting increased bubble volume and a compatibility change.

options.title: Retain current behavior
options.body: Keep paragraph-aware length chunking as documented and close the request as an unsupported presentation preference.

recommendation.title: Add explicit opt-in mode
recommendation.body: Keep current `newline` compatibility and add a distinct paragraph-per-bubble policy whose boundaries survive chunking and coalescing.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the prior implementation and have the clearest feature-history connection to the shared streaming boundary.
